property.name: CanAutoGenerateMipMap
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the driver is capable of automatically generating mipmaps.

property.name: CanCalibrateGamma
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the system has a calibrator installed that can automatically adjust the gamma ramp.
property.remarks: To invoke the calibrator when setting new gamma levels, set calibrate to true when calling SetGammaRamp . Calibrating gamma ramps incurs some processing overhead and should not be used frequently.

property.name: CanManageResource
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the driver is capable of managing resources.

property.name: ReadScanLine
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the display hardware is capable of returning the current scan line.

property.name: SupportsAlphaFullScreenFlipOrDiscard
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device can respect the AlphaBlendEnable render state in full-screen mode while using the FLIP or DISCARD swap effect.

property.name: SupportsCopyToSystemMemory
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device can accelerate a memory copy from local video memory to system memory.
property.remarks: This setting guarantees that GetRenderTarget calls will be hardware accelerated. If this setting is false , those calls will succeed but will be slower.

property.name: SupportsCopyToVideoMemory
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device can accelerate a memory copy from system memory to local video memory.

property.name: SupportsDynamicTextures
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the driver supports dynamic textures.

property.name: SupportsFullScreenGamma
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the driver supports dynamic gamma ramp adjustment in full-screen mode.

property.name: SupportsLinearToSrgbPresentation
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device can perform gamma correction from a windowed back buffer (containing linear content) to an sRGB desktop.

method.name: ToString
method.summary: Retrieves a string representation of this object.

overload.summary: Retrieves a string representation of this object.
